searchText: How much eth are we trying to lock up to kick start the chain? 512,000 = 32 * 16k validators? or is it 64k? Recent discussions are leaning toward 512k instead of the 2M currently in the contract. Ill make a PR shortly with rationale there ok cool Allocating 512k eth on Goerli rn <@291925846556540928> any thoughts about flattening the issuance % curve? 16K validators with a fully-behaving network would generate ~23%, but with a very sharp dropoff (32K would return ~16%, 64K would return ~11.5%)
